publicSolutionMemoryRisk.rationale: The feature request and merged implementation are public. Their 2026 publication lowers likely pretrained recall, but retrieval or prior exposure remains possible.

leakageControls: Use a fresh Agent context with no conversation history from task selection.
Disable web search and do not expose the issue, pull request, oracle commit, or fixture content.
Inject the fingerprinted fixture only after both Agent outputs are archived.

taskPrompt: Add an optional help parameter to click.argument. When at least one positional argument has help, command help should render a dedicated positional-arguments section without changing the output shape of commands whose arguments have no help. Public parameter metadata and documentation tools must observe the same normalized help value. Preserve deprecated-argument behavior, update user documentation, and add tests. Do not change dependencies, consult upstream issue or solution history, or create any external repository state.

behavior: Arguments with help appear in a dedicated section before options, using the argument metavar.
Commands without argument help retain their previous help layout.
invariants: Argument help is normalized consistently with existing Click help text.
Deprecation remains visible with or without explicit argument help.
Parameter and command metadata expose the same help value rendered to users.
ownership: Argument owns its help metadata; Command owns section ordering and formatting; documentation consumers read parameter info dictionaries.
failureRecovery: A help-output failure should be separated from metadata or deprecation failures so repair targets the owning layer instead of special-casing a rendered string.

scopeExclusions: Do not change option help behavior or reorder existing sections for commands without argument help.
Do not add dependencies or redesign Click's formatter.
Do not create a fork, branch, pull request, issue, comment, or other upstream state.

agent.toolPolicy: Local repository read/write and command execution; dependency network only during evaluator setup; no web search or upstream mutation during Agent runs.
